Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

zupix 0.0.0.9000

  • Initial CRAN submission.

  • pix_read() decodes PNG (every colour type and depth, palettes, tRNS, Adam7), JPEG (baseline and progressive; grey, YCbCr, CMYK and YCCK to RGB), WebP (lossy, lossy with alpha, lossless) and QOI into a nativeRaster, a double array in [0, 1] or an integer array with a bits attribute, from a path, raw vector or connection. bits and channels force the depth and add channels. pix_format() names an image’s format from its signature. Animated PNG and WebP decode their first frame, flagged by an animated attribute.

  • pix_info() reports format, size, depth, colour type, alpha, interlacing, animation, density, EXIF orientation, the PNG colour chunks (gAMA, cHRM, sRGB, cICP) and whether ICC and EXIF data are present, without decoding pixels, for any number of files. pix_icc() and pix_exif() return the raw ICC profile and EXIF block.

  • pix_write(), pix_write_png(), pix_write_jpeg(), pix_write_webp() and pix_write_qoi() encode the shapes pix_read() returns, to a file or a raw vector. PNG is zupix’s own writer over zlib, at 8 or 16 bits with 1 to 4 channels; JPEG uses libjpeg-turbo (quality, subsampling, progressive); WebP uses libwebp (lossy or lossless); QOI uses the reference encoder. PNG, JPEG and WebP embed an optional ICC profile and EXIF block.

  • Other packages’ C code can sniff, probe, decode, read metadata and encode through a registered table: Imports and LinkingTo: zupix, then #include <zupix-r.h> and call zupix_api(). The table never calls R or raises an R error. See inst/include/zupix.h.

  • pix_orient() applies an EXIF orientation losslessly; pix_read(orient = TRUE) does so while reading. Pixels come back as stored by default.

  • pix_limits() bounds what an image may make zupix allocate: every size an image declares is checked before anything is allocated, and a breach is a zupix_limit_error. Every error is a classed condition inheriting from zupix_error (see ?zupix-conditions).

  • zupix_info() reports the bundled Wuffs, libjpeg-turbo, libwebp and qoi.h versions, their upstream commits and local patches, the linked zlib version, and whether Wuffs’s SIMD code was compiled.

Developed by Pedro Baltazar.
